`seor` bundles a suite of focused R packages for SEO and web-developer
workflows into a single metapackage. Installing `seor` installs every member;
`library(seor)` attaches them all at once, in the style of the `tidyverse`
metapackage.

## Installation

`seor` is not on CRAN yet: a metapackage can go there only once all of its
hard dependencies have. Install it, with every member, from r-universe:

```r
install.packages(
  "seor",
  repos = c("https://bart-turczynski.r-universe.dev", "https://cloud.r-project.org")
)
```

Or the development version from GitLab. `pak` reads the `Remotes:` field in
`DESCRIPTION`, so the members not yet on CRAN are fetched too:

```r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("gitlab::bart-turczynski/seor")
```

Some members compile C or C++ code from source. punycoder uses `libidn2` when
it is present at build time, and robotstxtr needs a C++17 toolchain.

## Usage

```r
library(seor)
#> -- Attaching seor packages --
#>   v rurl      ...
#>   v punycoder ...
#>   ...

seor_packages()    # the member packages
seor_conflicts()   # name collisions among attached packages
```

## Members

Each member has its own site, and an `llms.txt` there for agents.

| Package      | Purpose                                        | On CRAN | Site | llms.txt |
|--------------|------------------------------------------------|:-------:|------|----------|
| `rurl`       | URL parsing and manipulation                   |   yes   | [site](https://bart-turczynski.gitlab.io/rurl/) | [llms.txt](https://bart-turczynski.gitlab.io/rurl/llms.txt) |
| `punycoder`  | Punycode / internationalized-domain conversion |   yes   | [site](https://bart-turczynski.gitlab.io/punycoder/) | [llms.txt](https://bart-turczynski.gitlab.io/punycoder/llms.txt) |
| `pslr`       | Public Suffix List lookups                     |   yes   | [site](https://bart-turczynski.gitlab.io/pslr/) | [llms.txt](https://bart-turczynski.gitlab.io/pslr/llms.txt) |
| `raddr`      | IP address parsing and classification          |   yes   | [site](https://bart-turczynski.gitlab.io/raddr/) | [llms.txt](https://bart-turczynski.gitlab.io/raddr/llms.txt) |
| `sitemapr`   | XML sitemap parsing                            |   no    | [site](https://bart-turczynski.gitlab.io/sitemapr/) | [llms.txt](https://bart-turczynski.gitlab.io/sitemapr/llms.txt) |
| `pagerankr`  | PageRank estimation                            |   yes   | [site](https://bart-turczynski.gitlab.io/pagerankr/) | [llms.txt](https://bart-turczynski.gitlab.io/pagerankr/llms.txt) |
| `robotstxtr` | `robots.txt` parsing (optional: attached once installed) | no | [site](https://bart-turczynski.gitlab.io/robotstxtr/) | [llms.txt](https://bart-turczynski.gitlab.io/robotstxtr/llms.txt) |
